verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents an official Auth0 MCP Server that lets AI agents such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf connect to a tenant over OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization. Through it, agents can create applications, manage users, deploy Actions, and debug logs. A first-party GitHub repo and a probe confirming the docs page back this up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as described.
